author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: 1.5.1 — Fixes a second LimitExceededException variant: the 401/403 retry path inside the async poll callbacks was still calling the synchronous, blocking token-refresh method, tripping the same excessive-hub-load guardrail from a different line. Token refresh is now fully async (refreshTokenAsync/handleTokenRefreshResponse), so no blocking calls remain anywhere in the poll path. Also logs a clear warning instead of silently no-op'ing when there's no active Wyze session.
